{"pagination":{"count":10,"page":1,"next_page":2,"total_count":1000,"total_pages":100},"records":[{"platform":"desktop","title":"Mintlify","url":"https://mintlify.com","uuid":"27815973-005b-4a09-b2e1-05a80ea27282","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/mintlify.com/27815973-005b-4a09-b2e1-05a80ea27282/preview_0.jpg","description":"Mintlify has a clean, light documentation-brand aesthetic with the feel of a polished digital librarian’s desk: calm, precise, and highly organized. The visual system is built on a bright white canvas with a broad amount of breathing room, strong black typography, and restrained gray supporting tones that keep the interface feeling quiet and authoritative. A vivid sage green is used sparingly as the signature accent for the logo, selected links, and primary calls to action, giving the whole experience a crisp, dependable focal point without overwhelming the page.

The typography is modern and confident, with large bold headlines set in a tight, refined rhythm and smaller text that stays highly legible and airy. Layouts are centered and container-based, with generous vertical spacing between sections, producing a structured editorial flow rather than a dense product dashboard. Navigation is minimal and persistent, with soft pill-shaped buttons and understated text links that feel premium but approachable.

Illustration plays a major role in the hero treatment: soft cloud-like abstract forms, gentle gradients, and atmospheric color washes create a serene backdrop around the content. Product visuals are framed inside clean cards or browser-like panels, reinforcing the documentation/software context while keeping the composition orderly. Cards are spacious, lightly elevated, and rounded at the corners, with subtle borders and shadows that add depth without visual weight. Overall, the design feels spacious, intelligent, and quietly branded, combining enterprise clarity with a friendly, contemporary software polish."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Perplexity AI","url":"https://www.perplexity.ai","uuid":"5c7acdfb-996b-4c6f-b361-264a3f580f7d","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/www.perplexity.ai/5c7acdfb-996b-4c6f-b361-264a3f580f7d/preview_0.jpg","description":"A restrained, light-toned AI interface with a soft parchment-like warmth, built from creamy off-white surfaces and charcoal typography. The overall feel is calm, intelligent, and quietly premium, with a minimalist editorial sensibility rather than a flashy tech look. The layout is spacious and centered, dominated by a fixed left sidebar and a clean main canvas that leaves generous negative space around the focal search area. Typography is simple and modern, with a refined sans-serif hierarchy that leans on size and weight changes instead of bold contrast. The brand mark sits lightly in the center, followed by a large rounded search field that acts as the visual anchor; its border is subtle, its corners are softened, and its controls feel compact and functional. Accent color is used sparingly in a muted teal, mostly for active navigation and small interactive details, which gives the interface a sense of quiet authority without disrupting the serene palette. Cards and suggestion panels use soft rounded rectangles with faint elevation, thin borders, and barely-there shadows, keeping the surface language delicate and tactile. The sidebar is understated and utility-driven, with compact icon-and-label items, gentle spacing, and a disciplined hierarchy that reinforces the product’s focused, information-first character. Overall, the design is polished, minimal, and composed, with a warm monochrome base, subtle contrast, and precise UI detailing."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Elementor","url":"https://elementor.com","uuid":"86351665-7483-48d1-9be4-5fe456093686","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/elementor.com/86351665-7483-48d1-9be4-5fe456093686/preview_0.jpg","description":"A stark monochrome, premium SaaS landing-page aesthetic built almost entirely on black, white, and soft off-white. The visual identity feels high-contrast and editorial, with a press-like seriousness where bold typography carries the design instead of color. The hero uses a full-bleed moody lifestyle photograph with large, tightly set white headline text layered over the image, creating a dramatic, poster-like opening. Type is heavy, compressed, and confident, with oversized weight-900 display styling and compact spacing that gives the layout a stamped, ink-on-paper feel. The top navigation is clean and restrained, set in a rounded white bar with minimal black text links and a single strong black call-to-action button. Surfaces alternate between pure black and bright white or soft foggy white, producing a checkerboard rhythm across the page. Cards are simple and geometric with generous padding, rounded corners, and no visible shadows, relying on surface inversion rather than elevation for hierarchy. Buttons are similarly minimal, with black-filled primary actions and white secondary actions, both sharply defined and highly legible. Supporting text appears in muted gray, while icons and dividers stay thin and understated. Overall, the look is polished, modern, and highly structured — a minimalist enterprise-SaaS style with an editorial edge and a strong sense of contrast, space, and typographic authority."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Raise","url":"https://opencollective.com","uuid":"f72e18d0-98f4-4e88-9754-5426589564ea","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/opencollective.com/f72e18d0-98f4-4e88-9754-5426589564ea/preview_0.jpg","description":"The interface has a clean fintech editorial feel with a spacious white canvas, strong navy typography, and a restrained blue-accent palette. It feels structured and trustworthy, like a modern financial platform or community funding dashboard. The hero section is centered and airy, with an oversized bold headline in deep navy and a short supporting paragraph beneath it, creating a clear, high-contrast hierarchy. Navigation is minimal and lightly framed, with small text links and compact rounded buttons that keep the header quiet and functional. The overall layout uses generous whitespace, balanced alignment, and a contained content width, giving the design a calm, architectural clarity.

Visual elements are soft and polished: cards sit on the page with subtle borders, light shadows, and rounded corners, while the content inside them is organized into tidy rows and compact data blocks. The UI relies on clean separators, fine strokes, and a very light neutral background treatment to preserve legibility without visual noise. The primary blue buttons stand out as the only vivid brand color, reinforcing the system’s disciplined, monochrome-first look. A hand-drawn illustration adds warmth and personality, contrasting gently with the precise interface geometry and making the page feel approachable as well as professional. Overall, it combines enterprise-grade clarity with a friendly, community-driven tone."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Ui","url":"https://ui.shadcn.com","uuid":"c14c0a94-1037-449e-bf5b-4cb972656ac7","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/ui.shadcn.com/c14c0a94-1037-449e-bf5b-4cb972656ac7/preview_0.jpg","description":"A stark monochrome design system with a clean, architectural blueprint feel. The interface sits on a bright white canvas with very subtle gray borders and minimal shadow, creating a crisp, highly controlled sense of order. Typography is the main visual voice: large, confident black headings paired with compact, precise body text and tight letter spacing, giving the whole layout a technical, editorial seriousness. The composition is centered and spacious at the top, then transitions into a dense grid of neatly aligned component cards below, which makes the page feel like a curated showcase of UI primitives rather than a marketing site. Surfaces are flat and restrained, with soft rounded cards, slightly sharper input fields, and pill-shaped buttons and badges that add a gentle contrast to the otherwise geometric system. The monochromatic palette dominates, with black used for primary actions and emphasis, light gray for separators and secondary states, and only tiny semantic accents for status cues. Icons are simple, monochrome, and functional, reinforcing the utilitarian, developer-tool aesthetic. Overall it feels polished, exacting, and quietly premium, with a disciplined balance between structure and softness."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Cron Calendar","url":"https://cron.com","uuid":"0528b40d-d5ef-4783-9206-d42fa97ad1d2","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/cron.com/0528b40d-d5ef-4783-9206-d42fa97ad1d2/preview_0.jpg","description":"A stark, minimal dark-mode landing page with a refined cockpit-like feel. The palette is dominated by near-black and deep graphite surfaces, lifted by crisp white typography and a single vivid orange accent used sparingly for the logo, primary action, and tiny highlights. The layout is clean and centered, with a simple top navigation bar, generous vertical spacing, and a strong hero hierarchy that places an oversized bold headline above smaller supporting text. A compact announcement pill sits above the main message, adding a subtle layered detail without disrupting the restraint of the composition. The overall typography feels sharp and modern, using a Helvetica Neue-style sans serif with strong weight contrast between the display headline and lighter body text. Buttons are compact, rectangular, and precise, with low-radius corners and minimal decoration, while the product screenshot below is presented as a flat, contained rectangle that reinforces the utilitarian, professional identity. The visual language is polished, direct, and highly legible, with subtle glow-like warmth around orange elements and an otherwise flat, high-contrast dark surface treatment."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Perplexity AI","url":"https://perplexity.ai","uuid":"b95e58ce-d00e-4de1-ad6b-6f1c7d7a5593","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/perplexity.ai/b95e58ce-d00e-4de1-ad6b-6f1c7d7a5593/preview_0.jpg","description":"A minimalist AI search interface with a calm, editorial, and highly restrained feel. The entire screen is built from warm ivory and soft parchment neutrals, with black and graphite text providing crisp contrast and a quiet premium tone. The layout is sparse and airy, centered around a large lowercase wordmark and a single prominent rounded search field, giving the composition a focused, almost academic clarity. A fixed left sidebar adds structure with compact stacked navigation items, subtle dividers, and small monochrome icons, reinforcing the utility-first character. Surfaces are flat and softly differentiated rather than heavily elevated, with only faint borders and very delicate shadowing. The typography is clean, modern, and unadorned, with a generous amount of whitespace that makes the interface feel pristine and uncluttered. Pills, tags, and controls are rounded and understated, creating a gentle tension between precise organization and approachable interaction. Overall it reads as a polished, light-mode productivity tool with a clinical calm, refined neutrality, and strong visual discipline."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Changelog","url":"https://linear.app/changelog","uuid":"11d3e58a-87d7-4a9a-bbf5-720f4fd3ffc6","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/linear.app/11d3e58a-87d7-4a9a-bbf5-720f4fd3ffc6/preview_0.jpg","description":"A dark, highly restrained devtools-style changelog layout with the polished atmosphere of a midnight command center behind frosted glass. The whole interface sits on an almost-black canvas with subtle grayscale layering and barely-there elevation, using borders and tonal shifts instead of shadows to create depth. Typography is the main visual hero: crisp Inter-driven text in a compact, disciplined hierarchy, with large headlines set in a refined medium weight rather than bold, giving the page an authoritative but understated feel. The top navigation is slim and low-prominence, with small text links and a soft pill-shaped sign-up button that stands out through its light fill rather than bright color.

The page structure feels centered, contained, and editorially organized, with generous vertical breathing room and a text-first rhythm. Changelog entries are presented as clean dark cards and stacked sections, each separated by thin graphite borders and modest 8px rounding. Monochrome icon clusters and contained product graphics act as functional focal points, adding a technical, product-aware layer without breaking the minimal mood. Search, tabs, and pills are all rounded to a 9999px capsule form, reinforcing the contrast between soft interactive elements and the strict, architectural framing of the content. Overall the style is quiet, precise, premium, and focused, with a deliberate monochrome palette and a subtle futuristic tone."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Modern Business Intelligence","url":"https://mode.com","uuid":"980966ef-e661-439d-8858-4cefe1e0451a","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/mode.com/980966ef-e661-439d-8858-4cefe1e0451a/preview_0.jpg","description":"A dark, editorial fintech landing-page aesthetic built around a deep forest-green canvas and vivid chartreuse highlight blocks. The overall feel is bold, confident, and highly branded, with a strong sense of contrast between the moody background and the bright lime-green headline containers that visually snap forward from the surface. Typography is large, blocky, and theatrical, using a serif display style for hero messaging that feels architectural and substantial, paired with smaller, clean sans-serif supporting text for navigation and body copy. The layout is spacious but tightly orchestrated, with left-aligned stacking, oversized hero typography, and a clear hierarchy that reads like a polished data lab or business-intelligence showcase. Rounded rectangles and soft 16px corners give the interface a friendly, modern polish, while the absence of shadows keeps everything feeling flat, crisp, and deliberately solid. Buttons and utility controls sit on pale paper-white surfaces or outlined dark treatments, creating a restrained but high-contrast navigation system. The imagery adds a human, collaborative layer with warm photographic scenes inside the otherwise graphic composition, reinforcing the blend of analytical precision and approachable enterprise style. Overall it feels premium, contemporary, and slightly experimental, with a vibrant neon-on-forest color story and a poster-like compositional rhythm."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Krea","url":"https://krea.ai","uuid":"3a63b3fa-dc79-4dc3-935e-3f8f4ab447a7","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/krea.ai/3a63b3fa-dc79-4dc3-935e-3f8f4ab447a7/preview_0.jpg","description":"A moody, high-contrast dark landing page with a restrained terminal-like luxury. The entire interface is built around near-black surfaces, luminous white typography, and very subtle gray separations, creating a crisp midnight command-center feel. The visual hierarchy is clean and centered, with a classic top navigation bar, generous breathing room, and a large hero composition that dominates the screen. Typography is modern, geometric, and confident, with a large display headline in tight spacing and smaller supporting text in soft gray for a precise, editorial tone.

The page combines atmospheric photography with product mockups: a dark, cinematic background scene anchors the hero, while the central monitor screenshot adds realism and product clarity. Buttons are minimal and polished, using rounded pill and rounded-rectangle forms with white and charcoal fills, giving the interface a calm, premium SaaS feel rather than a flashy startup aesthetic. Borders, shadows, and gradients are extremely subtle, used only to separate layers and add depth. Overall the design feels sleek, focused, and quietly futuristic, with a strong monochrome palette, balanced spacing, and a refined, high-end software brand presence."}]}

Typography is a defining part of the identity: oversized, commanding serif headlines create a sophisticated, almost magazine-like presence, while the supporting sans-serif body copy keeps the experience modern and highly functional. The interface styling is light and refined, with soft card corners, subtle borders, and minimal elevation. Product screenshots are framed like curated evidence, usually on white surfaces with gentle rounding and restrained shadows, while feature cards and content modules sit comfortably within a clean grid. Navigation is simple and persistent, buttons are pill-shaped and highly polished, and the whole design language leans into clarity, trust, and premium SaaS confidence without visual clutter."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Amie","url":"https://amie.so","uuid":"4a5ae758-c3cb-4bc6-9225-c30d93bfde24","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/amie.so/4a5ae758-c3cb-4bc6-9225-c30d93bfde24/preview_0.jpg","description":"A bright, minimalist productivity landing page with a crisp white canvas, airy spacing, and a restrained editorial hierarchy. Cards are white, rounded, and subtly lifted by hairline shadow rings that behave like invisible borders rather than obvious containers. This gives the interface a polished, almost floating flatness. Buttons are soft and rounded, with a clear hierarchy between the filled blue action and the ghost secondary option. Overall it feels sunlit, clinical, and highly focused — a polished productivity brand aesthetic that blends editorial typography, understated UI chrome, and one strong accent color to guide attention."}]}
